# Welcome {.unnumbered}

Welcome to AI workflow for clinical study development.
The goal of this book is to explore strategies to bring an organization from AI adoption to AI-native 
by building AI-first workflow for clinical study developments. 

An AI-first workflow leverage AI to develop and maintain pre-specified Agentic workflow that's 
defined and monitored by human to streamline clinical trial development. 

Whether you are new to AI  workflows or already working in clinical reporting,
you will find small, reusable examples you can adopt right away,
along with patterns 

**This is a work-in-progress draft.**
